Segments: what each gets, and is it working?

Every Star account gets the base package: Star partner status, annual health report, wellness credit, priority service. On top, each segment gets what fits why it would leave. A segment escalates when its lapses run more than 10% above plan.

2026 margin uplift, step by step

Full-year expected values on the filtered book, worst case if every step is used. Loyalty benefits and calls have no rate cost.

Match-to-retain: cut size set by FY25 MLR

Only when a broker shows a written competing quote or tender. Budget $10m a year.

FY25 MLRStar accountsMaximum offerWhy
≤ 40%2,048up to −5%Widest margin; pays if it saves the account ≥ 7% of the time
40–55%1,540up to −3%Thinner margin; smaller cut
55–70%1,107Experience refundPaid only if claims stay low, so it cannot lose money

Proactive calls: top 10% by value at risk

The account manager calls 90 days before renewal with the account's data and perks; a cut by MLR is offered only if they signal they are going to market. Next 3 renewal months.
